THE STRUCTURE-OVER-GATES CLAUSE IS NOT NEEDED AND IS NOT INVOKED: no gated criterion regresses, and C3c is BIT-UNCHANGED at 2/0/5 h against RT actuals 10/13/42. WHAT THIS IS: the MEMBERSHIP half of a correction that previously existed only on the reliability floor. reliability_floor_plant_exclusions (nyiso-140, keeper) never reached nyiso_gas_commitment_bridge, so nyiso-140 repaired one MECHANISM rather than the plant and the same economically laid-up stations stayed floored by the other mechanism that floors the same class -- rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH]'s 'enumerate what already floors the same class', one mechanism later. ONE differing scenario_config field: nyiso_gas_bridge_plant_exclusions False -> True. IDENTIFICATION (rules 13/23, source data only, NO residual consulted): a plant is in economic lay-up iff its median CAMPD plant gross load is ZERO in every (year, 4-hour block) cell of 2023-2025 -- the nyiso-140 criterion VERBATIM. The per-cell quantifier is what makes it a lay-up test rather than a low-capacity-factor test: on NYISO's own bridge population a POOLED median of zero also catches ordinary CYCLERS (Saranac P(on)=0.426, Port Jefferson P(on)=0.375), the very population a commitment bridge exists to hold together. The qualifying set stops at 18/18 zero cells; the nearest non-qualifier sits at 16/18. Twelve plants qualify (2480 Danskammer, 2625 Bowline, 2682 S A Carlson, 8006 Roseton, 10190 Castleton, 10620 Carthage, 10621 Syracuse, 50744 Sterling, 54034 Rensselaer Cogen, 54592 Massena, 54593 Batavia, 56188 Pinelawn), matching 98 fleet rows. NOT CIRCULAR, which is the whole point: the test reads ONLY the meter and is computed WITHOUT reference to which plants the bridge floors or to any D-4 verdict -- and it then selects 7 of the bridge's 8 D-4 unit-conduct FAILURES. That agreement is evidence, not fitting. RULE 21 [R-DOF]: ZERO new free parameters. DOF ledger 39 -> 40 entries, n_residual UNCHANGED at 6 -- the new entry is a plant-code SET produced by a conduct test, with n_scalars 0. ALL SIX PRE-REGISTERED KILL GATES PASS (PREREG-nyiso144-bridge-layup-membership-2026-08-18.md, committed BEFORE either arm solved; scorer scripts/probes/_nyiso144_layup_ab.py, record results/calibration/_nyiso144_layup_ab.json). K2's LIVENESS PREDICTION WAS NEARLY EXACT: the shed computed from the CONTROL's own D-4 rows before either solve was 0.1186/0.1396/0.3089 TWh against a +/-50 % band, and the measured shed is 0.1201/0.1406/0.3099 TWh -- within 1.3 % in every year. K3 membership exactness: ZERO stray losses and ZERO residuals, so exactly the declared set lost its floor. K4: D-4 unit-conduct failures fall 17 -> 3 with ZERO new failures. K6' did not even need to escalate -- unlike nyiso-140, EVERY material class's forced share FALLS (ST_GAS 20.2->19.7 / 24.9->23.9 / 16.7->14.7 %; CC_REGULAR 4.8->4.4 / 2.6->2.4 / 1.9->1.8 %). WHAT IT DOES NOT BUY, STATED PLAINLY: no fit improvement, and none was expected. Across BOTH full calibration_verdict reports the ONLY difference is a SKIPPED, NON-GATED day-ahead diagnostic line (C3a da_diagnostic +6.7->+7.0 % 2023, +0.3->+0.6 % 2024, -0.6->-0.2 % 2025). What it buys is LEGITIMACY (rule 1 [R-STRUCT]): the bridge stops manufacturing ~0.57 TWh over three years at plants whose own meter says they were mothballed. TWO PLANTS DELIBERATELY LEFT IN, both named in the pre-registration BEFORE the solve so neither could be added after seeing a residual: 7314 (the eighth D-4 FAIL, 77.1 % of its floored hours metered at zero) does NOT qualify -- it is a cycler the model's own P0 over-runs, so its forcing is an offer/economics defect and excluding it would bury that error inside a membership list (rules 1/14); it is the NAMED SUCCESSOR. And 2517 Port Jefferson stays in the BRIDGE population (its committed D-4 verdict on this mechanism is `pass` in all three years) even though it is correctly excluded from the reliability FLOOR, whose always-on baseline it does not have. CORRECTION TO THE RECORD, made before the solve: the nyiso-144 handoff (from RESULT-nyiso143 s6 / ASSESSMENT-nyiso143 s2.3) states the bridge floors 2517 for 0.1495 TWh in 2024, 34.6 % of that leg, 4,623 h, median 0.000 MW, 71.2 % at zero. The keeper's OWN committed legitimacy_diagnostics.json says 0.0616 TWh, 19.5 %, 1,716 h, median 45.222 MW, 44.7 % at zero, verdict PASS. The Roseton row matches the handoff exactly; 2517's and 7314's do not. The committed artifact is the source of truth. Rule 28(d)/25: this verdict transfers to NO other ISO, which must identify any laid-up unit from its OWN CAMPD conduct.
